answer: What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The relic holds work receipts rather than names, so the marble of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
